links.covers: Lithium: pre-lithium workup (SCr, electrolytes, TSH, UPT, CBC, EKG); monitoring BUN/Cr, electrolytes/calcium, TSH/PTH, lithium levels
Carbamazepine/oxcarbazepine: CBC w/ diff, LFTs, BUN/Cr, UA, sodium, eye exam/IOP, UPT; HLA-B*1502
Clozapine: ANC monitoring, metabolic labs, CRP/eosinophils/troponin
Second-generation antipsychotics: FBG, HbA1c, lipids, BMI after starting or a dose change
Risperidone: metabolic monitoring (FBG, HbA1c, lipids); hyperprolactinemia
Anorexia nervosa: lab and other findings
Alcohol: GGT, AST:ALT >2, LDH, CDT, MCV
Neuroleptic malignant syndrome: CK >1000 IU/L, leukocytosis
Ziprasidone: highest QT risk; EKG after dose increases, stop if QT >500 ms
TCAs: QT prolongation, torsades (sodium bicarbonate), overdose
Lithium: baseline EKG; bradycardia, abnormal T waves
Baseline cardiac evaluation before stimulants — Stimulants: raise HR/BP; avoid with known cardiac abnormalities (HF, recent MI, arrhythmia, moderate-severe HTN)
Alzheimer disease: MRI diffuse cortical atrophy
Vascular dementia: MRI white matter lesions, infarcts
